title.en: Customs (Exemption from Section 15(2) — Free Trade Agreements, etc.) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Customs (Exemption from Section 15(2) — Free Trade Agreements, etc.) Order 2022.

2. Section 15(2) of the Act does not apply in relation to any claim to pay customs duty or excise duty at the preferential rate levied under paragraph 4(1) of the Customs (Duties) Order (O 4), made pursuant to an agreement specified in the first column of the Schedule in relation to the goods specified opposite the agreement in the second column, if the condition specified opposite that agreement in the third column is satisfied, with effect from and including the date specified opposite that agreement in the fourth column.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
First column
Second column
Third column
Fourth column
Agreement
Goods
Condition
Effective date
1.Singapore‑Australia Free Trade Agreement
Goods which have originated from and consigned direct from Australia
The claim is made within one year after the date of importation of the goods
1 December 2017
2.Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‑Pacific Partnership
Goods which have originated from and consigned direct from any country that is a party to the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‑Pacific Partnership and has ratified the Agreement
The claim is made within one year after the date of importation of the goods
30 December 2018
3.Agreement between New Zealand and Singapore on Closer Economic Partnership
Goods which have originated from and consigned direct from New Zealand
The claim is made within one year after the date of importation of the goods
1 January 2020
4.Singapore‑Costa Rica Free Trade Agreement
Goods which have originated from and consigned direct from the Republic of Costa Rica
The claim is made within one year after the date of importation of the goods
1 June 2022
5.Agreement between Singapore and the Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu on Economic Partnership
Goods which have originated from and consigned direct from the Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu
The claim is made within one year after the date of importation of the goods
1 June 2022
